[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Security model"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| Layer | Enforcement |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| Explorer root | every read/write is containment-guarded against an explicit root; the guard is **f"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"ail-closed** (a root that cannot resolve, or a target outside it, rejects the call) |
| Writes | `fi"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"le.write` **requires an explicit root** — link-opened or restored tabs may read without one by expli"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"cit user intent, but never write |
| Version guard | saves carry the `FsVersion` observed at read ti"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"me; a file changed elsewhere rejects the save with `stale` instead of silently overwriting |
| Trunc"},{"id":"p27s6","text":"ation guard | files not fully loaded (>256 KB) cannot be edited, so a save can never truncate the re"},{"id":"p27s7","text":"st of the file |
| Host sandbox | the underlying `fs` sandbox (e.g. `workspace-write`) remains the o"},{"id":"p27s8","text":"utermost boundary |

| Markdown | link/image URLs are scheme-whitelisted (`javascript:`/`data:` render inert) |"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Failures are never silent: save / load-more / root-pick errors surface in an
in-panel notice."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- **One package, two halves.** The Loader row (`id: filelens`) loads the Host
service; the browser h"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"alf is picked up automatically from the `dsh.client`
declaration.
- **No generated artifacts.** The "},{"id":"p30s3","text":"Host registers its nine invocation
definitions into `typert.local` at service construction (src-json"},{"id":"p30s4","text":" codecs,
zero extra dependencies), so the gateway resolves them in any install shape.
- **Direct tra"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"nsport.** The browser half POSTs the same `client-request`
envelope to `/api` that the built-in conn"},{"id":"p30s6","text":"ection uses — no `ctx.remote`
namespace injection, no mount-order pitfalls.
- **Host-side engineerin"},{"id":"p30s7","text":"g.** Incremental reads continue a cached stream
(O(n) per session instead of O(n²)); search/grep wal"},{"id":"p30s8","text":"ks abort on a new
request via AbortController; errors map to structured `FsError` codes.
- **Zero ru"},{"id":"p30s9","text":"ntime npm dependencies** beyond the `@deepseek-ai/cordis` /
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-protocol` peers"},{"id":"p30s10","text":" the harness already provides."}],"truncated":true}
